title: Trade high-value purchase approval attempt binding
description: Server-owned binding facts for the initial HIGH_VALUE_APPROVAL assurance profile. This object is neither a credential nor a policy decision. Its shape does not register an endpoint, capability, issuer policy or grant.

attempt_id.description: Server-minted unique attempt. Retries of this attempt retain the same identifier and binding.

authentication_binding.description: IAM-issued confidential binding over the verified issuer, subject, provider session and confidential BFF session. A caller-supplied digest is not evidence.

approval_id.description: Trade PurchaseApproval identifier in PENDING state at challenge creation and execution.

approval_revision.description: The Trade-owned approval row revision, distinct from the version of the underlying purchase.

step_up_rule.description: Applicable governed A3 step-up rule in the transaction currency. An approver's independent spending ceiling is a distinct business constraint.

authority_digest.description: Binding to current security and commercial authority state, including applicable policy and membership revisions. Independently refreshed decision IDs and observation times are excluded from state equality.
